beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley settles into the chair Dave just left.

options.text: Do I know you from somewhere?

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I got offered a spot on tour with this band. But I'd have to drop out of my program to do it. I don't know if that's brave or just stupid."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: A fresh start — one thing ending as another begins.
You're throwing away everything you worked for.
This card isn't about decisions like that.

elaboration: The Fool doesn't grade what you're leaving behind — it just marks the exact moment one door closes and another opens.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't know, dropping out feels pretty reckless."

options.text: It's standing at the edge, calm, not scared of falling.
Reckless is exactly the right word.
The edge doesn't really mean anything here.

elaboration: Reckless would be jumping without noticing the edge at all. The Fool sees exactly where it's standing and steps off anyway.
